definitions: A small bag, often made of leather or other fabric, used especially by women for carrying money, keys, and other personal items.
A sum of money offered as a prize in a contest or as a gift.
A puckering or contracting of the lips or a part of the body.
examples: She opened her purse to find her keys.
The winner took home a purse of ten thousand pounds.
He gave a slight purse of his lips.
